keyLimits.en: Base package with unlimited cards, users, and control settings: physical/virtual cards, OCR receipt tracking, expense management, budget monitoring, multi-entity management, API access, SSO/SAML. Priced via custom quote combining a fixed subscription fee plus variable transaction-based fees.

addOns.en: Optional modules: Procurement, Accounts Payable, advanced workflows & policies, multi-entity management, HR/ERP integrations, AI-based automation and fraud detection.

cautions.en: Pricing has two components: a fixed monthly subscription fee for platform access, plus variable fees tied to transaction volume (card purchases, invoices, expense claims); neither component's amount is published.

capabilities.en: Issues unlimited physical and virtual corporate cards with spend controls, as part of the base Foundations package.
Automates receipt capture via OCR and expense/reimbursement management.
Supports multi-entity management and integrates with accounting tools such as Xero, QuickBooks, and Datev via API.

limitations.en: No public pricing; every plan requires contacting sales for a custom quote, making cost comparison difficult upfront.
Advanced modules (Procurement, Accounts Payable, HR/ERP integrations, AI fraud detection) are separate paid add-ons on top of the base Foundations package.

reason.en: Competing business finance platform combining business banking with expense/card management.

unknowns: No public price point exists for Foundations; exact fixed fee and transaction-based fee rates were not disclosed on the pricing page.
Whether a free trial exists was not stated on the pricing page.
